result.title: SkillEarth: Teaching General-Purpose Agents to Act on Earth via Skill Evolution
result.summary: Recently developed remote sensing (RS) agents execute real-world tasks with complex workflows through multi-step tool invocation. These agents, however, typically rely on predefined expertise or parameter updates. They thus require updating expert knowledge or retraining models whenever new tools, tasks, or execution patterns emerge, limiting their continual adaptability in dynamic Earth environments. In this work, we seek to equip general-purpose agents with RS tool-call knowledge that can be automatically extracted from demonstrated trajectories without expert intervention or parameter updates. Specifically, we propose SkillEarth, a self-evolving skill extraction method that externalizes RS tool-call knowledge as reusable, retrievable, and evolvable skill files and refines them through observation-grounded evolution. Unlike existing automatic skill extraction methods that rely on outcome-based reflection to refine skills holistically, SkillEarth grounds skill evolution in real tool-chain execution and combines dual-judge feedback with a grounded observation routing graph for precise component-level refinement. The resulting skills are generalizable, reliable, and transferable: they improve overall RS tool-call performance across three frontier LLMs and four open-source LLMs, are refined through real tool execution feedback, and support cross-model reuse without retraining. Experiments on OpenEarth-Bench and Earth-Bench demonstrate that SkillEarth achieves better tool selection, argument correctness, execution-order consistency, and task completion than existing RS agents and skill extraction methods.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向遥感多步工具调用智能体，提出 SkillEarth：从示范轨迹中自动抽取可复用、可检索、可演化的「技能文件」，并借助真实工具链执行反馈、双评委信号与观测路由图做组件级精修，从而在不更新参数的情况下提升工具选择、参数与执行顺序表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以真实执行反馈做组件级精修、将能力外化为可演化技能文件而非参数更新」的做法，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督的贡献分配与「外部证据/技能 vs 内部 latent 状态」的取舍提供可供核查的对照线索。
